title: Familiar Embodiment Binding Schema (familiar.embodiment_binding.v1)
description: JSON Schema for the textual (JSON) encoding of one Familiar Embodiment Binding (profile v1, OpenCoven/familiar-contract#17). A binding proves which familiar root and exact identity revision a concrete runtime session embodies: which familiar persisted into the execution, at which revision, under which principal and validity state. A binding carries digests and stable opaque references by default; it never copies sensitive declarations, memory, relationships, or personal data. It does not grant runtime capabilities, authorize protected actions, or author run lifecycle state — those are separate, correlated authorities. The bindingIntegrityDigest is a SHA-256 content fingerprint (RFC-0001 §5.6.1 content-fingerprint role) over the canonical encoding of the binding object with the bindingIntegrityDigest member removed; identityDeclarationDigest is a SHA-256 content fingerprint over the identity declaration manifest's canonical bytes. All identifiers are stable opaque strings. Unknown members are rejected (fail closed); extension requires a profile version bump.

schema.description: Profile discriminator. Carries the profile and schema version; the presence of a second mutable version field would invite drift, so policy versioning is carried separately in policyVersion.

bindingId.description: Unique opaque identifier of this binding. Stable opaque reference; MUST NOT encode display names or personal data.

familiarRootId.description: Stable opaque familiar root identity — the continuity anchor that survives revision evolution. Alias resolution MUST produce exactly one root; a human-readable familiar name/alias is input convenience and never the root of trust.

identityRevisionId.description: Opaque identifier of the exact identity revision embodied. Selected at dispatch/session creation, not frozen when a routine is authored.

revisionIndex.description: Monotonic position of the revision in the root's revision sequence. 0 denotes the genesis revision.

identityDeclarationDigest.description: Canonical identity declaration/bundle digest: SHA-256 over the identity declaration manifest's canonical bytes per identityCanonicalization. This is the normative identity digest boundary.

identityCanonicalization.description: Versioned canonicalization rule used for identityDeclarationDigest (v1: UTF-8 canonical JSON of the identity declaration manifest — see schemas/familiar-embodiment-binding.md §7).

relationship.description: Machine-verifiable relationship to the prior revision. Same-familiar continuity, fork/new-root distinction, and succession mapping MUST be verifiable from this evidence, never inferred from names or similar content.

priorRevisionId.description: Prior revision this entry continues from. MUST be a non-null opaque revision identifier for every relationship except genesis.

priorRootId.description: Root of the prior revision. MUST be a non-null opaque root identifier for fork and succession entries (cross-root); same_familiar and restoration continue the same root.

evidenceDigest.description: Optional content-addressed reference to the lineage evidence record (e.g. the succession, fork, or restoration decision record) retained by the identity registry.

recordedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC recorded time of the lineage event.

lineage.description: Predecessor/root lineage evidence needed to verify same-familiar continuity. A genesis revision MUST carry either an empty array or a single genesis entry.

recordedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC recorded time — when the identity registry recorded the revision.

validFrom.description: RFC 3339 UTC start of the revision's valid-time interval.

validUntil.description: RFC 3339 UTC end of the revision's valid-time interval, or null for an open interval. Recorded time and valid time are interpreted per schemas/familiar-embodiment-binding.md §7.4.

status.description: Ratified revision status vocabulary, observed at decision time. A resolver MUST NOT issue a binding whose decision-time status is not active; the non-active values exist so that refusal records and decision-time evidence share one vocabulary without retroactive mutation of committed bindings. When present, the status is the decision-time snapshot and is immutable after commit.

principalId.description: Authenticated principal to which the familiar is bound for this embodiment. Stable opaque identifier; the selected revision MUST be valid for execution under this principal.

projectScope.description: Project/scope binding where relevant; null when the embodiment is not project-scoped.

correlationTarget.description: Session/run/attempt correlation target — the identifier of the execution this binding commits to.

bindingPurpose.description: Binding purpose/profile: direct Coven launches, scheduled automation runs, or Psyche-delegated work. Direct, automation, and Psyche sessions use one binding profile; purpose MUST NOT change identity meaning. New purposes require a profile version bump (closed enum, fail closed).

issuedAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC issued/decision timestamp — when the final validity check passed and the binding was committed.

policyVersion.description: Version of the validity/lifecycle policy under which this binding was issued. Verifiers MUST refuse results rendered under policy versions they do not support.

resolverId.description: Identity of the resolver/verifier that performed alias resolution and the final validity check.

contentAddress.description: Content address of the retained historical identity bundle: SHA-256 over the bundle manifest's canonical bytes. Enables content-addressed historical rehydration (schemas/familiar-embodiment-binding.md §9); the preimage is registry-retained and is not embedded here.

locator.description: Retrieval locator for the retained bundle, or null when the locator is withheld (privacy minimization, erasure, or tombstone).

bindingIntegrityDigest.description: Integrity/authentication field: SHA-256 content fingerprint over the canonical encoding of this binding object with the bindingIntegrityDigest member removed. Unkeyed in v1 — tamper-evident for corruption and drift; adversarial authentication (keyed commitment or signature) is a ratified-extension decision (see schemas/familiar-embodiment-binding.md §6.4). Committed binding bytes/digest MUST be verified before launch success is returned.

privacyClass.description: Privacy/retention classification of the binding and its retained material. standard: opaque identifiers only. sensitive: retained material requires additional authorization for bundle reads. tombstoned: erasure has been applied; bundle components may be absent and verification degrades (fail closed, never overclaim).

supersededBy.description: Identity revision that supersedes this revision. MUST be present when status is superseded.

sha256Hex.description: Textual hash encoding per RFC-0001 §5.6.1: exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters (a raw 32-byte SHA-256 value), bare — no sha256: prefix, no uppercase. Algorithm fixed by each field's definition; no discriminator field appears in this schema.
